reason: A DeepSeek Harness credential provider that stores and accesses user-bound encrypted credentials, supports explicit legacy migration, and provides encrypted portable export on Windows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Windows 用户绑定保护的凭据存储、写入和迁移能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with Windows user-bound credential storage, write-only access, and explicit legacy migration support.

capabilities: Stores credential references and encrypted credential values using Windows DPAPI
Provides write-only credential access and configuration status reporting
Migrates selected values from a legacy plaintext credentials file
Exports encrypted credential backups using scrypt and AES-256-GCM
